args.command: echo '=== VISUALIZER SERVICE ==='; systemctl is-active zen-living-visualizer.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== RUNTIME HEAD ==='; git -C /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== PROVIDER DETECTION SOURCE ==='; grep -n 'provider_text =' /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime/deploy/ubuntu/zen-living-visualizer.py 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== LIVE UPDATER BAD NEWLINE COUNT ==='; grep -F -c '\\ninstall' /usr/local/sbin/zen-ops-update 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== API STATE SUMMARY ==='; curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:18992/api/state | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("authority")); print([(a.get("name"),a.get("status"),a.get("station")) for a in d.get("agents",[])])' 2>/dev/null || true
